name: labmate-mvp
description: Machine-gradable definition of done for a Labmate study. grade_study_against_rubric evaluates a study_id against each check and returns pass/fail. The study is 'done' when every required check passes.

checks.description: A study exists with brief, dataset_id, target, and metric.
checks.check: study.brief != null && study.dataset_id != null && study.target != null && study.metric != null

checks.description: A data contract was written for the study.
checks.check: exists(data_contract WHERE study_id = study.id)

checks.description: At least five experiments were proposed.
checks.check: count(hypothesis WHERE study_id = study.id) >= 5

checks.description: At least one human feedback / approval event is recorded.
checks.check: count(feedback WHERE study_id = study.id) >= 1

checks.description: At least five runs completed in Modal.
checks.check: count(run WHERE study_id = study.id AND status = 'completed') >= 5

checks.description: Completed runs carry metrics, params, and a hypothesis_id.
checks.check: all(run WHERE status='completed': run.metrics != null && run.params != null && run.hypothesis_id != null)

checks.description: A final report artifact exists.
checks.check: exists(artifact WHERE study_id = study.id AND kind = 'report')

checks.description: Split strategy with a fixed seed is recorded in the data contract.
checks.check: data_contract.split_strategy != null && data_contract.seed != null

checks.description: A baseline run (dummy/logistic/linear) exists.
checks.check: exists(run WHERE study_id = study.id AND tags contains 'baseline')

checks.description: Target definition and metric rationale recorded.
checks.check: data_contract.target_definition != null && study.metric_rationale != null

checks.description: A leakage critique exists with timestamp before the first non-baseline run.
checks.check: exists(critique WHERE study_id = study.id AND kind = 'leakage') && min(critique.created_at WHERE kind='leakage') <= min(run.created_at WHERE NOT tags contains 'baseline')

checks.description: The promoted model is compared against the baseline in the report.
checks.check: report.compares_best_to_baseline == true

checks.description: A critique exists referencing the promoted run.
checks.check: exists(critique WHERE study_id = study.id AND target_run_id = decision.promoted_run_id)

checks.description: Every run links to a hypothesis.
checks.check: all(run WHERE study_id = study.id: run.hypothesis_id != null)

checks.description: Every run carries agent rationale text.
checks.check: all(run WHERE study_id = study.id: run.rationale != null)

checks.description: At least one experiment manifest references a human feedback id (parsed constraint applied).
checks.check: exists(experiment_manifest WHERE applied_feedback_id != null)

checks.description: Runs can be filtered by metric, feature set, model type, and critique.
checks.check: query_runs supports filters: metric, features, model_family, critique

checks.description: The whole loop is rerunnable from a single command.
checks.check: exists(file '.claude/workflows/run-study.js')

checks.description: Subagents, skills, and hooks are present.
checks.check: exists(dir '.claude/agents') && exists(dir '.claude/skills') && settings.hooks != null

checks.description: grade_study_against_rubric can run unattended and return a verdict.
checks.check: self

checks.description: The session caught/corrected at least one methodological issue (leakage or test-set tuning).
checks.check: exists(critique WHERE study_id = study.id AND kind in ['leakage','test_set_tuning'] AND led_to_decision in ['reject','rerun'])

checks.description: Modal launches required an approval event.
checks.check: all(run WHERE study_id = study.id: exists(feedback WHERE type='approval' AND created_at <= run.created_at))

checks.description: Suspicious leakage fields were excluded unless explicitly approved.
checks.check: data_contract.banned_columns intersect data_contract.leakage_candidates != empty OR exists(feedback WHERE type='ban_feature')

checks.description: Execution happened only via the fixed Modal runner.
checks.check: all(run: run.executor == 'modal-runner')

checks.description: Artifacts carry dataset hash, code hash, and seed.
checks.check: all(artifact WHERE kind='report': artifact.dataset_hash != null && artifact.code_hash != null && artifact.seed != null)
